name: Terminator Zero
description: A warrior from a post-apocalyptic future travels to 1997 to protect an AI scientist being hunted by an unfeeling — and indestructible — cyborg.

credits_cast.character: KOKORO / KOKORO SPIRIT / KOKORO MIND / KOKORO HEART (voice)
credits_cast.name: Atsumi Tanezaki

videos.title: Model 101
videos.overview: In 1997, a haunted scientist brushes his family aside for an all-consuming project. In 2022, a renegade fighter battles a powerful robot for vital data.

videos.title: Model 102
videos.overview: Eiko and the Terminator arrive in 1997 with identical missions: find Dr. Malcolm Lee. Meanwhile, Lee's three children sneak out of their apartment.

videos.title: Model 103
videos.overview: Malcolm confides in Kokoro about his recurring nightmare. The three children continue their underground trek, unaware of looming danger.

videos.title: Model 104
videos.overview: As a desperate Eiko attempts to elude the police, Misaki's mysterious past comes into focus. Malcolm wrestles with the nature of fate.

videos.title: Model 105
videos.overview: Malcolm brings Kokoro online. The boys disagree about Misaki's motivations. Eiko realizes she's entering unknown territory.

videos.title: Model 106
videos.overview: The Prophet debates the paradox of time travel with Eiko. Malcolm shares a painful memory with Kokoro as the children hope to reunite at Cat Town.

videos.title: Model 107
videos.overview: Malcolm recalls past efforts to thwart the machines — and his desire to build a god. With Kenta captured, the Terminator prepares for the endgame.

videos.title: Model 108
videos.overview: Kenta wrestles with a brutal choice and the Terminator reveals a shocking truth as the future of humankind hangs in the balance.
